description: TY2026: the OBBBA re-based SS 461(l) indexing and the threshold WENT DOWN — Rev. Proc. 2025-32 SS 3.31 verbatim: '$256,000 ($512,000 for joint returns)'. An MFJ $600,000 loss is fully allowed in 2025 (under $626,000) but has $88,000 disallowed in 2026. Thresholds that fall year-over-year are exactly what recalled knowledge gets wrong.
